<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex203_2024-09-1111-40-4131" status="reviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">dbu' ma pa kha cig</rs><note type="gloss">
 <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">klu sgrub</rs> kyi rjes su 'brangs pa de'i gzhung legs par mi shes pa</note> na re | 'di ji skad bya ba yin khyod kyi <note type="gloss">°°°°°nyid du shes pa <expan>med</expan> pa'i</note> rgyu mtshan de ni myi 'grub ste |  gzhi zhes bya ba ni rten 'brel yin la de'i rang bzhin ni stong pa yin pas | nyan thos dang rang rgyal <lb n="62b7"/> gyis kyang de shes la des na rten 'brel shes pas stong pa shes pa'i phyir | dus gsuM mnyam par shes pas de'i thabs su 'dra'o zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
